convert_fullcell_to_halfcell_voltage: convert a full cell voltage value to half cell voltage vs SHE or RHE scale
get_she_voltage: get the SHE voltage from a full cell voltage measurement using calibration data
convert_she_to_rhe: convert a potential from SHE scale to RHE scale given pH and reference electrode potential
correct_potential_with_ir_drop: correct a measured potential by applying IR drop compensation using current, resistance, and area
calculate_overpotential: calculate the overpotential as the absolute difference between measured and theoretical potential
